name: ShopifyQLProductSearch
description: Find a product, price, or online/store availability, including a product named alone ('a Minions costume', 'tires'). Follow-up questions about those products, which are in stock, their price, the second one, or the cheapest use the shown-result context. Extract a new search_query only when the caller names a new product or changed features. Explicit variant or color changes are a new search, not permission to drop those constraints. Store availability requires a chosen product and city/state/ZIP. Not placed orders (ShopifyQLTrackOrder), policies (ShopifyQLStorePolicies), advice or greetings (None); the interest, APR or financing terms of buying on credit ('¿cuánto de interés?', 'what is the interest rate') (None).

parameters.description: Product type, brand and features named by the caller, in the original language. Extract the product phrase from a question asking whether it is sold, its price or availability.
